thread:
maya: Heads-up — quick sync about the roles UI. Compact rows look neat but admins report they can’t scan permissions quickly. Thinking we need a middle ground.
liam: Agree. Compact mode should be denser but still surface key perms. Maybe show primary perms inline and hide advanced ones behind chevrons.
sophia: +1. Also seeing confusion in invite flow copy when SSO is enforced for orgs — users think they still need to set a password.
jordan: Oof. Can you paste the current text?
maya: Current microcopy: `You can invite users. They will sign in with your org’s SSO.` Admins said it sounds optional.
sam: Quick copy options to test (short use test A/B):
```
A) "Invited users must sign in via your organization's SSO. No password required."
B) "SSO required: new users will sign in with your SSO provider. They won’t create passwords."
C) "SSO enforced — use your identity provider to access the org."
```
liam: I prefer B for clarity, but trim "create passwords" maybe "won't set up a password" is softer.
sophia: Also add an inline help link: "Why SSO enforced?" that opens a tiny modal with a11y-friendly content.
jordan: Back to roles matrix — keyboard users need to jump to the audit log and to role details. Current UI requires tabbing a lot. Any ideas for an accessible jump nav?
maya: Proposal: add a short skiplist at top of table: `Skip to: Role details | Audit log | Invite flow`. Implemented as visible buttons for sighted users and as a hidden skiplink for screen readers.
eng-bot: Note: rollout checklist — make sure skip links are focusable and have aria-controls pointing to section ids. Also add role rows `aria-expanded` states for chevrons.
sam: UX nit: chevrons should have visible targets and a11y labels like `Expand advanced permissions for Role X` instead of `Toggle`.
liam: On compactness vs clarity, maybe introduce a density toggle with two presets: "Comfortable" and "Condensed" and a small example snapshot so admins know what changes.
sophia: We should surface a tooltip on the density toggle explaining tokenized benefits: "Condensed saves vertical space, may hide advanced perms — use for large orgs."
jordan: One more: audit log navigation — add a mini timeline scroller on the right side for fast jump to date ranges. But ensure keyboard operable and high contrast.
maya: Great. Action items: 1) Sam to run microcopy A/B with B trimmed. 2) Liam to mock the condensed row with inline primary perms + chevron. 3) Jordan to prototype skiplist + audit scroller keyboard behavior. 4) Sophia to draft tooltip copy and SSO modal content.
sam: I'll recruit 5 admins for quick usability test tomorrow.
sophia: I'll add these to the PR description so reviewers know the a11y expectations.
liam: Quick call? 15 min after standup to align on components?
maya: Yes — ping me at :bell: then.
eng-bot: Deploy bot: reminder — design changes touching table rows need migration flags in feature-flags.json.
maya: Thanks all — saving notes to the design doc. :thumbsup:
